literal: Without discerningly understanding, the kohl-painted eyes which looked, now without being pitied and understood, why do they suffer distress?
translation: Why do these kohl-painted eyes, which gazed at him without foreseeing the consequences, now suffer this distress when he does not pity or understand their pain?
modern: விளைவை ஆராய்ந்து அறியாமல் அன்று காதலனைப் பார்த்த மைதீட்டிய கண்கள், இன்று அவர் இரங்கி அருள் செய்யாதபோது துன்பத்தை அனுபவிப்பது ஏன்?
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine laments the state of her own eyes which are weeping due to separation from her lover. She addresses them with gentle irony, asking why they are suffering now. When they first eagerly looked at him, they did so blindly without discerning the future pain of parting (தெரிந்துணரா நோக்கிய). Now, when the lover is away and does not pity or understand their plight (பரிந்துணரா), the eyes endure deep sorrow (பைதல் உழப்பது). She highlights that the eyes brought this misery upon themselves by looking at him in the first place.
